fact: WHO's biennium report for 2020-2021 states that routine data collection in Eritrea is still paper based, collected by health workers in health facilities and then sent to the zobas for entry into DHIS 2, with 98 per cent of facilities submitting their routine reports every month; and that the national DHIS2 server installation and upgrade was carried out by HISP Tanzania with support of Oslo University and GAVI, coordinated by WHO and UNICEF.
title: WHO Eritrea Biennium Report 2020 - 2021: Consolidating Achievement of UHC in Eritrea
